exposure: Delivery mode of the second twin
internal podalic version followed by breech extraction
Internal podalic version followed by breech extraction
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 457 twin pregnancies with gestational age ≥34 weeks where the first twin was delivered vaginally
finding: While cesarean section was the more frequent delivery mode for the second twin, internal podalic version and breech extraction was associated with a slight tendency for better neonatal outcomes, including a lower rate of asphyxia.
mod_finding: The study found a slight tendency for better neonatal outcomes in the internal podalic version and breech extraction group compared to the cesarean section group for the delivery of the second twin.
